title: The Lighthouse That Answered
logline: Nell rows across a frozen sea to a lighthouse dark for forty years, and discovers what her missing mother has been doing there all along.
hook: For forty years, the lighthouse at Harrow Point has been dark. Last night, it blinked.
place: an abandoned lighthouse on a frozen sea

character.name: Nell Harrow
character.appearance: young woman in her twenties, short dark hair, determined eyes, carrying an old brass lantern
character.clothing: red hooded oilskin coat, dark boots
character.style: cinematic photo, moody, volumetric fog, shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: For forty years, the lighthouse at Harrow Point has been dark. Last night, it blinked.
scenes.visual: tall lighthouse alone on a frozen sea at dusk, one red light glowing in the fog
scenes.background: a tall lighthouse alone on a frozen sea at dusk, one red light glowing in the fog, purple and pink sky

scenes.narration: Nell rowed out across the ice alone, because the light was blinking in her mother's code.
scenes.visual: small figure in a red hooded coat walking across ice toward a distant lighthouse, holding a lantern
scenes.background: frozen sea at dusk with a distant lighthouse on the horizon, cracked ice, soft purple pink sky

scenes.narration: Inside, every step upward matched a name carved into the wall. Hers was waiting at the top.
scenes.visual: figure in a red hooded coat climbing a spiral staircase, warm lantern light
scenes.background: inside a stone lighthouse stairwell, spiral stairs rising, names carved into the stone walls, warm lantern glow

scenes.narration: In the lamp room, the ancient lens turned by itself, and the fog began to pull back.
scenes.visual: glowing lighthouse lamp with golden light beams, figure in a red hooded coat in silhouette
scenes.background: dark circular lamp room at night, one huge glowing golden lens in the center, soft light rays

scenes.narration: Beneath the ice, thousands of lights blinked awake. Ships, lost for decades, waiting to be seen.
scenes.visual: frozen sea at night with many small glowing lights beneath the ice, one lighthouse beam above
scenes.background: calm frozen sea at night under stars, soft blue and gold lights glowing beneath clear ice, wide empty scene

scenes.narration: Her mother never vanished. She kept the light burning, so the lost could find their way home.
scenes.visual: figure in a red hooded coat standing quietly, a faint golden glow of a second figure beside her
scenes.background: warm golden light filling a lighthouse lamp room at dawn, round windows, soft glow

scenes.narration: Now Nell lights it every night. And every night, someone comes home.
scenes.visual: lighthouse at sunrise with warm light, small boats on calm water
scenes.background: lighthouse at sunrise, warm pink and gold sky, small sailing boats on calm water, hopeful
